mechanism: Retail-sales growth tracks household consumption, the largest component of GDP; strong consumer spending is risk-on for equities and slowing spending is an early demand-softening signal. Exposure is scaled toward SPY when retail-sales growth is firm.
key_finding: Best search-phase rule uses mom at L9 with OOS Sharpe 1.36 versus buy-and-hold 0.99.
caveats: Retail sales is broadly coincident with the cycle, so a long apparent lead is likely a search artifact.
The strategy is search-selected and needs fresh holdout validation.
The 2020-21 COVID collapse/rebound is an extreme in-window outlier that can dominate the fit.
Advance retail-sales figures are revised in subsequent Monthly Retail Trade releases.
narrative_summary: RSXFS growth is tested as a procyclical consumer-demand overlay for SPY, not as a clean leading indicator.
